top_signals.title: Fed-Treasury ‘Regime Change’ May Fuel Bonds, Citrini Says
top_signals.summary: The Treasury Department and Federal Reserve are moving toward a more coordinated approach that could shift government borrowing toward shorter-term debt and reduce the supply of longer-dated Treasuries, setting the stage for a rally in 30-year bonds, according to Citrini Research.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Okta's stock skyrockets 29%, CrowdStrike's surges 19% as rising AI threat boosts earnings
top_signals.summary: AI adoption is pushing customers to spend more on cybersecurity tools from companies such as CrowdStrike and Okta
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025
top_signals.summary: In the 2026 release of our Liquids Pipeline Projects Database, we tracked the completion of 8 liquid fuels pipeline projects since the start of 2025, and an additional 14 new projects have been announced.
